visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Merge Instead of Concatenate and Sort
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The two sorted arrays are joined and then bubble sorted again, which wastes the fact that they are already sorted. Replace it with a single merge pass. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Merging touches each element once (about n + m steps) while concatenating and bubble sorting takes about (n + m) squared steps. This is exactly the merge step of merge sort.
